_schema: Run 29 session 2 - Phase-5 reasoning audit: hallucination check, logic-break check, determinism + verbatim caveats (R5/R6/R7/R10/R13).

hallucination_audit.method: Every candidate technique's arXiv ID was independently re-searched by Phase-4 verifiers AND title-confirmed; candidate-relevant code repos were README-fetched by the main agent via raw.githubusercontent (R13).

hallucination_audit.readme_check_note: All THREE new-this-session candidate techniques (CANDI C9, EnFlow C11, AFINs C12) are README-confirmed (HTTP 200). The SGNO/SAM-Audio/Toto2.0 candidates are session-1 techniques whose code was confirmed in session 1.
hallucination_audit.note: No fabricated arXiv IDs, titles, or repos detected. One sourcing agent (TECH-2) PROACTIVELY excluded PackFlow (2602.20140) after finding its apparent repo was an unrelated tool - anti-hallucination behaviour, recorded honestly.

logic_break_audit.finding: Two-stage optimism containment. The Phase-3 pairing proposer (claude -p opus) reproduced session-1's documented over-excitement: 6 of 12 candidates carried a preliminary OPEN guess. The Phase-4 adversarial verifiers reduced this to 5 OPEN (e.g. correctly downgrading C6 kiln-heat-work and C7 slag to NARROW). The MAIN-AGENT independent crosscheck (strict gate) then overturned ALL 5 remaining OPEN labels to NARROW.
logic_break_audit.systematic_bias_identified: Both the proposer and the verifiers tended to equate 'the EXACT technique x application slice is unmade' with OPEN. Under the strict gate that is NARROW (capability-gap), because in every one of the 5 cases real adjacency exists - usually the SAME technique-family already applied to an industrial or sibling domain (PINN quench-field surrogate; PI-FNO tunnel-fire; ML AD-foaming prediction; ViscNet glass viscosity; overtone visualizers + isolated-overtone dataset).
logic_break_audit.containment_result: 0 false WIN escaped. No candidate reached GAP_OPEN. The crosscheck is the load-bearing defense, exactly as in session 1.
logic_break_audit.process_fix_for_session_3: Instruct Phase-4 verifiers explicitly: ANY prior adjacency (same technique-family on a sibling/industrial domain, OR the application served by a different method) => NARROW. Reserve OPEN for ZERO adjacency on BOTH axes. This pre-empts the optimism bias before the crosscheck stage.

determinism.note: Sourcing (8 agents) + verification (5 agents) + pairing (1 opus subprocess) + crosscheck (main agent) all ran over LIVE web search, so exact result SETS are not bit-reproducible. Robustness comes from redundancy: 5 reformulated searches/candidate + an independent main-agent crosscheck on every OPEN claim. No verdict survived as OPEN under crosscheck; the NARROW verdicts each rest on >=1 cited adjacency.

verbatim_caveat_R5_R6: WebFetch / direct arxiv.org fetch returned HTTP 403 in both agent sandboxes and the main-agent context (confirmed: arxiv.org -> 403). Therefore verbatim_quote values are 'as seen in WebSearch result blocks', NOT hand-verified against live arXiv pages. Code-usability WAS hardened beyond snippets for candidate-relevant techniques via raw.githubusercontent README fetches (HTTP 200 for CANDI, EnFlow, MolCrystalFlow, SymTorch). Agents recorded only results actually seen; uncertain/unconfirmed items were marked has_usable_code=false or excluded.
